subjects.title: Geography
subjects.standfirst: GCSE summer 2027 — three papers, built from the school’s own case studies

moduleGroups.title: Paper 1 — Living with the Physical Environment
moduleGroups.note: 1 hour 30 · 88 marks · 35% — natural hazards, the living world, UK physical landscapes.

moduleGroups.title: Paper 2 — Challenges in the Human Environment
moduleGroups.note: 1 hour 30 · 88 marks · 35% — urban issues, the changing economic world, resource management.

moduleGroups.title: Paper 3 — Geographical Applications
moduleGroups.note: 1 hour 15 · 76 marks · 30% — issue evaluation from the pre-release booklet, and fieldwork. Includes 6 marks for spelling and grammar.
